metadata.title: Write Integration Tests
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create comprehensive integration tests that verify complete flows of system components working together. Use for API, subscriber, or job testing.

specificActions: Study Existing Test Patterns: Review similar integration tests; note mocking patterns and test data builders
Set Up Test Infrastructure: Configure test server or message consumer; set up WireMock for external services; configure test database
Create Test Class Structure: Create test class with appropriate base class; set up DI for tests; create setup and teardown methods
Write Test Scenarios: Happy path tests; validation failure tests; external service failure tests; edge case tests
Verify and Run Tests: Run all tests; verify database state assertions; verify mock interactions
tools: run_terminal_cmd - Run tests with dotnet test
bestPractices: Search for similar integration tests before writing
Cover happy path, failures, and edge cases
